args.subject: Group Booking Availability – 10 Guests in June 2024
args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

I found your group-bookings contact address through your guest reviews and I'm writing on behalf of a group of 10 people who are interested in staying at City Hub Tokyo in June 2024.

Could you please let me know:
- Whether you have availability for a group of 10 guests in June 2024
- Any group rates or bulk-booking discounts you can offer
- Whether there are minimum-stay requirements or deadlines for securing a group rate
- Whether you can accommodate room configurations for 10 guests (e.g. twin/double rooms), and any available meeting or common-room space for the group

Our dates are still flexible within June, so I'm happy to work around your availability. Please let me know what details you need from me (such as preferred dates, room preferences, or a booking reference) and I'll provide them promptly.

Thank you for your help.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
+1 327-420-4923
